title: Debit card transactions remain weak in August; credit card volumes rise 26%, spends however soften
summary: Debit card transaction volumes increased around 2 per cent month-on-month in August 2026, while transaction value rose about 1 per cent, according to RBI data analysed by 1Lattice. On a year-on-year basis, however, debit card transaction volumes declined around 10 per cent and value fell about 6 per cent. Credit card transaction volumes grew around 4 per cent sequentially and 26 per cent annually, while transaction value declined about 3 per cent month-on-month but increased around 6 per cent year-on-year.
